derivation: from a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G4982 (σώζω);

occurrences.text: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;
If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.
Wherein they think it strange that ye run not with them to the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you:

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
